canonical_title: Microsoft withdraws from Nscale Loughton AI data-centre agreement
aliases: Microsoft pulls out of UK data center deal with Nscale
Loughton Essex AI supercomputer anchor tenant withdrawal
treatment: Do not repeat the October 18 agreement withdrawal without a new official contract, power, financing or project milestone.
known_facts: Reuters reported at 2026-10-18 10:01 UTC (19:01 JST) that Microsoft had terminated its agreement for the Nscale Loughton, Essex AI data-centre project, citing The Telegraph.
Nscale acknowledged a London-area grid issue and said the withdrawal does not affect its other Microsoft contracts.
Power supply for the site reportedly may not be available until the 2030s; Microsoft had not publicly stated its reasons at Reuters publication.
reinclude_only_if: Microsoft or Nscale provides a new official contractual explanation or reversal.
New verified project cancellation, power connection, funding or customer agreement materially changes outlook.
notes: Night window verified from Reuters timestamp; grid delay was previously known, contract withdrawal is new. Oct 18 midday output not available.
